title: Ethereum L2 Landscape 2026: Comparative Analysis
description: Comprehensive comparison of major L2 solutions including Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and zkSync with performance benchmarks and security trade-offs.
encryptedContent:
## Ethereum L2 Landscape 2026

### Key Findings

Base leads in TVL growth while zkSync shows strongest ZK proof efficiency.

- **Base**: $12B TVL, 65M tx/day
- **Arbitrum**: $9B TVL, 42M tx/day
- **Optimism**: $7B TVL, 38M tx/day
- **zkSync**: $4B TVL, 28M tx/day

### Security Comparison

All major L2s have completed Stage 1 decentralization. Base and Optimism share the OP Stack codebase.

title: Ethereum Foundation publishes mandate outlining its role as ‘one of many steward
encryptedContent:
Ethereum Foundation publishes mandate outlining its role as ‘one of many stewards’ of the network

The Ethereum Foundation mandate codifies Ethereum’s core “CROPS” principles: censorship resistance, open source, privacy and security.
